annotation.interpretation_a: The origin must publish an "ech" SvcParam for *all* alt-authorities it publishes.
annotation.interpretation_b: The origin must publish an "ech" SvcParam for *at least one* alt-authority it publishes.
annotation.justification: The word "any" is ambiguous. It could mean 'all' or 'at least one'. This affects the implementation because a server could choose to only publish the ech parameter for a subset of its alt-authorities, which would be a valid interpretation of "any" meaning "at least one", but might not be what is intended.
annotation.missing_information: The meaning of "any" is unclear. Does it mean all, or at least one? This affects whether implementations need to check all alt-authorities or can stop after finding one.
